test_island_feature_maps_initialization: test that each island gets its own empty feature map dictionary in ProgramDatabase
test_program_added_to_correct_island_fea: test that programs are added to their target island feature map via db.add with target_island
test_feature_coordinate_isolation: test that identical feature coordinates on different islands do not conflict with each other
test_better_program_replaces_in_island_f: test that a higher scoring program replaces a worse one in the same island cell
test_checkpoint_serialization_preserves_: test that saving and loading a ProgramDatabase checkpoint preserves all island feature maps
